reuse.why: Routes every server-side and preview computation of the expected amount through the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper that the client already used.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline midpoint copies (schedule template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) instead of editing each.

placement.why: The rule changes in shared/schedules.ts, the shared module that both server and client already import it from.

scope.why: Only the rule, its call sites and tests for the helper change.

maintainability.why: The expected-amount rule now has one definition with tests, so future changes are made once.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The previous bypasses of getScheduledAmount are replaced by calls to it.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplication remains; the inline copies were deleted.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the existing client callers.
